source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Look at failed vehicles inspected within the past 15 days.
3. Look at two failed vehicles with inoperable service brake condition. Example: Service Brakes Inoperable L, R, or B.
4. Look at two failed vehicles with inoperable defect of the service brake components. *49b7 Failure of a single component, such as a brake drum, adjuster, rotor, brake lining, hose, flexible hose, caliper, wheel cylinder, actuator, slack adjuster, lining adjustment, or another brake related component which makes that brake inoperable.
5. Select a document that displays inoperable service brake condition or inoperable service brake component.
6. Use the "Paint" function to mark with a red X the condition of the service brake.
7. If the inoperable condition you see is not on the "Paint" menu, you can insert the shape you want to use in
